verdict.rationale: Activepieces lets users decide where their data lives by running on its EU cloud or entirely inside their own network or infrastructure. Documented self-hosting options include a one-line installer, Docker, and Docker Compose, so residency is set by where you deploy. Missing for 10: a documented hosted-cloud region selector or other cloud regions beyond the EU, dedicated data-residency or compliance documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
